entries.12376b7dd313eeb4: Its mission is to 'contribute to the development of transportation infrastructure through electrical equipment,' and it states that the Electrical Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business will remain its core business. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it aims to become a company loved and trusted by customers, by upholding a customer-first principle in an environment of high-mix, low-volume production, taking on new technology development, and consistently delivering high-quality products.
entries.1459fe50a8ae5dd5: Since its founding in 1911, the company has accumulated experience in manufacturing and selling lighting and wiring equipment for railway rolling stock. It has a record of starting sales of Japan's first automatic subtitle-type destination indicator in 1965 and Japan's first in-car indicator for railway rolling stock in 1984; in 1955, it received a production designation from the Defense Agency (now the Ministry of Defense) for lighting, wiring, and signaling equipment for naval vessels, and it has continued to supply ships for a long time.
entries.1615a658c64e914a: A reportable segment that operates a real estate leasing business with a total of five buildings: four rental apartment buildings owned in Katsushika-ku, Tokyo, and one rental apartment building owned in Matsudo, Chiba Prefecture. entries.1eb1959fc64a22af: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,638 million, down 6.2% from the previous year.
